## What

One or two sentences describing what this PR changes.

## Why

The problem or motivation. Link the related issue if one exists (Closes #N).

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added/updated for new logic (app/src/test)
- [ ] No secrets or API keys in the diff
- [ ] Tested on device or emulator (which one? which Android version?)
- [ ] RTL + dark theme checked if UI changed
- [ ] ZIP safety limits unchanged (1 MB/file, 200 KB text cap)

## Notes for reviewers

Anything needing extra attention, plus known follow-ups.
